prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 21 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1177; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the other vehicle was changing lanes. The reported mechanism is consistent with the knee injury described, and the nature and force of the impact align well with the findings documented at intake. Initial evaluation included a detailed history and physical examination. Several orthopedic findings support a soft tissue injury to the knee, including localized tenderness and reduced range of motion on flexion, while other provocative tests returned within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment to the same body region is known from the patient's history or available records. Care was delivered over 21 visits and consisted of physical therapy, anti-inflammatory medication management, and home exercise instruction. Treatment progressed in a typical pattern, with visit frequency reduced steadily as symptoms improved and function returned. Billing records reflect services that align with the documented plan of care, with no repeated or duplicate charges. Patient was discharged from active care with a plan for self-directed exercise and follow-up as needed.
